game.title: The Last of Us™ Part I

roadmap.title: Part I story and full collectible route
roadmap.description: Finish Part I on any difficulty while following the chapter-order collectible route, preserving shivs for all 13 locked doors, concentrating parts on the Revolver, and completing the six Part I situational achievements.

roadmap.title: Left Behind story, interactions, and contests
roadmap.description: Finish Left Behind on any difficulty, collect its artifacts and conversations, exhaust Ellie's final joke set, and complete the arcade, brick, water-gun, and infected-lure challenges as they appear.

roadmap.title: Chapter and Encounter Select cleanup
roadmap.description: Reload the Story Complete autosave after each earlier-chapter cleanup, use Encounter Select for any unfinished melee-weapon or crafting credit, and collect the final meta achievement after the other 28 unlock.

achievements.sortReason: Awards only after every other achievement in the Steam list.
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 28 Steam achievements across @loc{Part I} and @loc{Left Behind}.

guide.context: @loc{Left Behind} is included in the standard game and contributes six dedicated achievements plus artifacts, conversations, and Ellie's final joke set.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Part I} and @loc{Left Behind} on any difficulty.
Complete every collectible, crafting, upgrade, and situational achievement until the Steam list shows @mechanic{28 of 29} unlocked.
Return to gameplay or the main menu after the twenty-eighth unlock so Steam can award the final completion achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Completes at the end of the Part I route.
achievements.summary: Finish the complete @loc{Part I} campaign on any difficulty.

guide.context: Combat, navigation, and traversal accessibility options remain eligible and can reduce the campaign's execution burden.

steps.text: From the main menu, start or continue @loc{Part I} on any difficulty.
Complete every story chapter through @loc{Jackson} and remain in the game until the ending finishes.

achievements.sortReason: Left Behind's closing sequence awards this after the campaign ends.
achievements.summary: Finish the complete @loc{Left Behind} campaign on any difficulty.

guide.context: The included expansion accepts the game's combat, navigation, and traversal accessibility options without blocking its ending achievement.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Left Behind} from the main menu and select any difficulty.
Complete every Left Behind chapter through @loc{Escape from Liberty Gardens} and wait for the ending to finish.

achievements.sortReason: The final pendant is in The Firefly Lab near the end of Part I.

achievements.sortReason: The sixth and final joke is in Left Behind.
achievements.summary: Hear all six of @npc{Ellie's} complete joke sets across @loc{Part I} and @loc{Left Behind}.

guide.context: The tracker misleadingly shows three jokes and advances only on sets 4–6. Chapter Select files joke sets under Optional Conversations, and several sets require waiting in place after setup interactions.

collectibles.name: Highway bus joke set
collectibles.method: After clearing the highway hunters, wait one or two minutes in front of the bus without climbing it, prompt Ellie, and hear the complete set.

collectibles.name: Bookstore joke set
collectibles.method: After clearing the bookstore, wait one or two minutes for Ellie to produce the joke book, then prompt her and hear the complete set.

collectibles.name: Woman's portrait joke set
collectibles.method: Complete the optional conversation at the woman's storefront portrait, wait one or two minutes, then prompt Ellie and hear the complete set.

collectibles.name: Hotel lobby joke set
collectibles.method: Collect Note to Staff, open the reception safe with 22-10-56, take Shiv Reinforcement, return up the ladder, and wait for Ellie to finish the set.

collectibles.name: Suburbs joke set
collectibles.method: Enter the road-bend house through its broken wall and hear Henry's first story; cross the street and speak to Henry in the corner house; use the ice-cream-truck conversation; hear Henry's second story beside the dogs and Firefly graffiti; then wait there until Ellie finishes the set.

collectibles.name: Carousel joke set
collectibles.method: After the carousel exchange, choose every available joke until Ellie exhausts the book.

achievements.sortReason: The last manual is in the Bus Depot tunnel.
achievements.summary: Collect all 12 @item{Training Manuals} across @loc{Part I}.

guide.context: Manuals improve the durability or effectiveness of crafted gear. Chapter Select records each pickup immediately, and Shiv Reinforcement is stored inside the Pittsburgh hotel safe.

collectibles.name: Shiv Sharpening
collectibles.method: Collect the manual from the end of the bar beside Bill.

collectibles.name: Health Splinting
collectibles.method: In the opening garage, go upstairs into the side room and search the mattress.

collectibles.name: Shiv Reinforcement
collectibles.method: Open the safe behind reception with @mechanic{22-10-56} and collect the manual from inside.

collectibles.name: Melee Knots
collectibles.method: Continue along the upper hallway and collect the manual from the desk.

collectibles.name: Molotov Construction
collectibles.method: After the apartment cutscene, enter the kitchen and search the counter.

collectibles.name: Bomb Containment
collectibles.method: After triggering the noise trap, continue forward and search the metal shelving.

collectibles.name: Melee Techniques
collectibles.method: In the white-house bedroom, inspect the ceiling hatch and boost Ellie so she retrieves the manual.

collectibles.name: Smoke Chemistry
collectibles.method: After crossing the dam, enter the building and collect the manual from the overturned locker.

collectibles.name: Health Sterilization
collectibles.method: After the barbed wire, use the broken windows on the right, climb to the balcony, re-enter through the next window, and search the desk.

collectibles.name: Molotov Deployment
collectibles.method: Inside the lecture room, collect the manual from the right-hand table.

collectibles.name: Smoke Shaping
collectibles.method: Open the shiv door behind the motel and collect the manual from the crate inside.

collectibles.name: Bomb Shrapnel
collectibles.method: Use the side tunnel in the Clicker-and-Bloater area, emerge beside the truck, and climb onto its roof.

achievements.sortReason: Concentrate parts on the Revolver during the Part I collectible route.
achievements.summary: Purchase every upgrade for one @item{weapon} at @mechanic{workbenches}.

guide.context: The Revolver is the least expensive weapon to complete at 155 parts. Higher tiers remain locked until Joel collects the corresponding Workbench Tool levels.

steps.text: Reserve at least @item{155 parts} for the @item{Revolver} instead of distributing every part across other weapons.
Collect the five red @item{Workbench Tool} boxes to unlock every required upgrade tier.
At any @mechanic{workbench}, select the Revolver and purchase each remaining upgrade until every Revolver slot shows complete.

achievements.description: Break into every locked door using shivs
achievements.sortReason: The last shiv door is in The Firefly Lab.
achievements.summary: Open all 13 locked @mechanic{shiv doors} across @loc{Part I}.

guide.context: Every locked door consumes one shiv. Keep Binding and Blades for doors instead of spending every shiv on stealth kills; Chapter Select retains each opened-door registration.

collectibles.name: Downtown door
collectibles.method: After the first Clicker encounter, pass through the next room and open the locked door.

collectibles.name: Museum kitchen door
collectibles.method: After Joel is separated from Tess and Ellie, reach the Clicker kitchen on the left and open the door.

collectibles.name: Ledge door
collectibles.method: After dropping from the outside ledge, turn left and open the locked door.

collectibles.name: Marquis Music Store rear door
collectibles.method: Pass the Clicker-triggered bomb behind Marquis Music Store and open the door behind the building.

collectibles.name: Bookstore restroom
collectibles.method: Climb to the bookstore's barista area and open the locked restroom door beside it.

collectibles.name: Taxi-area door
collectibles.method: After the bookstore cutscene, move left from the starting taxi and open the door.

collectibles.name: Ration Depot back room
collectibles.method: Enter the Ration Depot at the street's end and open the locked rear room.

collectibles.name: Room 201
collectibles.method: Descend the apartment stairs and open the locked @loc{Room 201}.

collectibles.name: Dam stairway door
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs toward the dam and open the locked door directly ahead.

collectibles.name: Lecture Room
collectibles.method: Follow the corridor to its end and open the locked lecture-room door.

collectibles.name: Motel rear door
collectibles.method: During the snowstorm, cross the street, pass through the motel, and open the locked door behind it.

collectibles.name: Tunnel gate door
collectibles.method: After Ellie helps open the gate, pass through the next door and turn immediately right.

collectibles.name: Hospital reception door
collectibles.method: Reach Floor 6 and open the locked door behind the reception desk.

achievements.sortReason: The last workbench is in the Bus Depot tunnel.
achievements.summary: Interact with all 11 @mechanic{workbenches} across @loc{Part I}.

guide.context: A workbench registers as soon as Joel opens its interface; buying a weapon upgrade is unnecessary. Chapter Select can recover any skipped bench.

collectibles.name: Museum workbench
collectibles.method: Pass through the garage door and open the workbench beside the next route door.

collectibles.name: Bill's Armoury workbench
collectibles.method: Enter Bill's Armoury and open the workbench at the rear.

collectibles.name: Pittsburgh garage workbench
collectibles.method: Enter the garage back room containing Ambush Map and open the workbench.

collectibles.name: Hotel workbench
collectibles.method: After escaping the basement, enter a room on the right and open the workbench.

collectibles.name: Financial District workbench
collectibles.method: Pass through the garage door, climb over the debris, and open the workbench beside the route.

collectibles.name: Red-building garage workbench
collectibles.method: From the ice-cream truck, enter the open garage in the red building and open the workbench.

collectibles.name: Dam workbench
collectibles.method: After crossing the dam, enter the building and open the workbench beside Smoke Chemistry.

collectibles.name: Flamethrower-room workbench
collectibles.method: Enter the room containing the flamethrower and open the workbench.

collectibles.name: Science Building workbench
collectibles.method: Once inside the Science Building, use the workbench in the first side room to the left.

collectibles.name: Medical-tent workbench
collectibles.method: From the large tent containing Workbench Tool #5, enter the tent on the right and open the workbench.

collectibles.name: Tunnel workbench
collectibles.method: After Ellie helps open the gate, pass through and open the workbench beside the next door.

achievements.sortReason: The fourth safe appears in The Suburbs.
achievements.summary: Open and empty all four @mechanic{safes} across @loc{Part I}.

guide.context: The combinations are fixed, so reading the nearby code artifacts is optional. Remove the contents after opening each safe so the collectible registers.

collectibles.name: Downtown subway safe
collectibles.method: In the infected subway shops, enter Round Note across from Note to Derek, use @mechanic{03-43-78}, and take the contents.

collectibles.name: Bill's Town street safe
collectibles.method: Open the safe beside the pickup truck on the right side of the street with @mechanic{05-17-21}, then empty it.

collectibles.name: Hotel reception safe
collectibles.method: After finding Note to Staff, return downstairs behind reception, use @mechanic{22-10-56}, and take every item.

collectibles.name: Suburbs house safe
collectibles.method: In the white house's first bedroom on the floor above ground level, beside Survivor's Note, use @mechanic{08-21-36} and empty the safe.

achievements.sortReason: The fifth tool level is in the Bus Depot medical tents.
achievements.summary: Collect all five red @item{Workbench Tool} boxes across @loc{Part I}.

guide.context: Workbench Tools unlock successively higher weapon-upgrade tiers and are the only collectible type that Chapter Select does not track.

collectibles.name: Workbench Tool Level 1
collectibles.method: Enter Bill's Armoury and collect the red toolbox from the room on the left.

collectibles.name: Workbench Tool Level 2
collectibles.method: In the opening garage, collect the red toolbox from the bench beside the party.

collectibles.name: Workbench Tool Level 3
collectibles.method: After crossing the water, enter the storage room on the left and collect the red toolbox.

collectibles.name: Workbench Tool Level 4
collectibles.method: Inside the lecture room, collect the red toolbox from the left-hand table.

collectibles.name: Workbench Tool Level 5
collectibles.method: After leaving the bus station, enter the large medical tent and collect the red toolbox.

achievements.displayName: Build Em Up, Break Em Down
achievements.description: Upgrade and then break one of every melee weapon
achievements.sortReason: Weapon types appear progressively through Part I and remain farmable through Encounter Select.
achievements.summary: Upgrade a @item{2×4}, @item{baseball bat}, @item{lead pipe}, @item{machete}, and @item{hatchet}, then break each upgrade on enemies.

guide.context: A melee upgrade uses Binding and Blade and adds one to three lethal durability segments according to collected manuals. Credit arrives when the added segment breaks, not when the upgrade is crafted.

steps.text: Load @loc{Pittsburgh — Hotel Rooms}, take a @item{2×4} from a hunter beyond the first left window, collect Binding and Blade in the right hotel rooms, craft the melee upgrade, and strike enemies until the added segment breaks.
In @loc{Pittsburgh — Hotel Rooms}, collect the @item{baseball bat} from the upstairs hallway cabinet, craft its upgrade with hotel-room materials, and expend the upgraded segment on enemies.
In @loc{Pittsburgh — Hotel Rooms}, take the @item{lead pipe} from the first corridor hunter beyond the right window, craft its upgrade, and break the upgraded segment during combat.
Load @loc{Tommy's Dam — Ranch House}, take the @item{machete} from the upstairs enemy, collect the upstairs Binding and Blade, craft the upgrade, and expend the upgraded segment.
Load @loc{Bus Depot — Tunnel}, turn around from the spawn, collect the @item{hatchet} from the far-left corner, use the starting materials to upgrade it, and kill a Runner to break the added segment.

achievements.sortReason: The first pendant appears in The Quarantine Zone.
achievements.summary: Collect one @item{Firefly pendant}, such as David Michael Vigil in @loc{The Quarantine Zone}.

guide.context: David Michael Vigil is the earliest reliable pendant and lies on the floor, so no ammunition or special prerequisite is needed.

steps.text: In @loc{The Quarantine Zone — Beyond the Wall}, climb into the building and enter the side room.
Pick up the @item{David Michael Vigil pendant} from the floor beside the mattresses.

achievements.sortReason: The first manual appears in Bill's Safehouse.
achievements.summary: Collect one @item{Training Manual}, such as Shiv Sharpening in @loc{Bill's Safehouse}.

guide.context: Shiv Sharpening is the first manual on the normal story route and improves the durability of crafted shivs.

steps.text: Continue @loc{Bill's Town — Safehouse} until Joel stands near Bill at the bar.
Pick up the @item{Shiv Sharpening manual} from the end of the bar beside Bill.

achievements.sortReason: The first tracked comic appears at the start of Pittsburgh.
achievements.summary: Collect one @item{Savage Starlight comic}, such as Termination Shock in @loc{Pittsburgh}.

guide.context: Termination Shock is the first comic that contributes to the 13-comic tracker; the unrelated issue already present in the inventory does not count.

steps.text: In @loc{Pittsburgh — Alone and Forsaken}, finish the opening garage section and reach the highway.
Enter the bus directly ahead and pick up @item{Termination Shock}.

achievements.sortReason: All six recipes are available from Pittsburgh onward.
achievements.summary: Craft one @item{Health Kit}, @item{Molotov}, @item{Shiv}, @item{Melee Upgrade}, @item{Bomb}, and @item{Smoke Bomb}.

guide.context: Every recipe is available from Pittsburgh onward. Achievement credit survives Checkpoint Restart, allowing the same supply cache to cover recipes that share components.

steps.text: Combine @item{Alcohol} and @item{Rag} to craft a @item{Health Kit}.
Combine @item{Alcohol} and @item{Rag} to craft a @item{Molotov}.
Combine @item{Binding} and @item{Blade} to craft a @item{Shiv}.
Hold a @item{melee weapon}, then combine the weapon with @item{Binding} and @item{Blade} to craft a @item{Melee Upgrade}.
Combine @item{Explosive} and @item{Blade} to craft a @item{Bomb}.
Combine @item{Sugar} and @item{Explosive} to craft a @item{Smoke Bomb}.
steps.note: If materials run out, restart the checkpoint or load @loc{Bus Depot — Tunnel} through Encounter Select and craft the remaining category.

achievements.description: Pick up Frank's note after it's discarded
achievements.sortReason: Performed at the end of Bill's Town while collecting Frank's artifacts.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Bill's Town}, give @item{Frank's note} to @npc{Bill}, then retrieve the crumpled note after he discards it.

guide.context: Both versions of Frank's note count as artifacts, and the second pickup appears only after Bill reacts to the first.

steps.text: In @loc{Bill's Town — High School Escape}, enter the back room of the house containing the vehicle and take @item{Note from Frank} from the desk.
Return to @npc{Bill} and use the prompt to give him Frank's note.
Wait for Bill to throw the note beside the truck, then pick up @item{Note from Frank (crumpled)} from the ground.

achievements.description: While in stealth, turn off the spotlight generator in Pittsburgh
achievements.sortReason: Performed at the Pittsburgh checkpoint near the chapter end.
achievements.summary: Disable the Pittsburgh @mechanic{spotlight generator} without leaving stealth or being detected.

guide.context: Detection before or during the generator interaction invalidates the attempt, but a checkpoint restart returns Joel to the start of the guarded section.

steps.text: In @loc{Pittsburgh — Escape the City}, reach the hunter checkpoint near the end of the chapter and remain crouched.
Approach the first two guards, stealth-kill one, and let @npc{Henry} eliminate the other.
Move clockwise behind the barriers while staying outside the spotlight and wait until the roaming hunter leaves the generator.
Approach the @mechanic{spotlight generator} unseen and switch it off.
steps.note: Restart the checkpoint immediately if any hunter detects Joel before the generator stops.

achievements.description: Ride the sewer contraption with Henry and Sam
achievements.sortReason: Performed during the mandatory sewer water-room puzzle.
achievements.summary: In @loc{The Suburbs — Sewers}, board the moving contraption with @npc{Henry} and @npc{Sam} before it crosses the water room.

guide.context: The contraption departs automatically when Ellie starts the generator, leaving only a short swim back to Henry and Sam.

steps.text: In @loc{The Suburbs — Sewers}, reach the large water room containing the central contraption.
Retrieve the wooden pallet and ferry @npc{Ellie} across the water to the generator platform.
As soon as Ellie leaves the pallet to start the generator, swim back to @npc{Henry} and @npc{Sam} and climb onto the contraption before it moves.
steps.note: Restart the checkpoint if the contraption begins crossing before Joel boards.

achievements.description: Leave Ellie hanging after a job well done
achievements.sortReason: Performed during the opening dam-gate puzzle.
achievements.summary: Ignore @npc{Ellie's} high-five prompt after she raises the gate at @loc{Tommy's Dam}.

guide.context: The prompt follows the opening dam-gate puzzle and lasts only while Ellie stands beside the crossing.

steps.text: In @loc{Tommy's Dam — Hydroelectric Dam}, retrieve the wooden pallet, ferry Ellie across the water, and let her raise the dam gate.
Cross the raised gate and walk past Ellie without using the @mechanic{high-five} prompt.

achievements.sortReason: Buckley appears during Tommy's dam tour after the gate puzzle.
achievements.summary: Pet @npc{Buckley} while the dog chews a ball during @npc{Tommy's} dam tour.

guide.context: Buckley appears after the dam-gate puzzle, just before the tour enters the next building.

steps.text: During @loc{Tommy's Dam — Hydroelectric Dam}, follow Tommy across the top of the dam toward the next building.
Before entering the building, approach @npc{Buckley} while the dog chews a ball and use the pet prompt.

achievements.description: Play the Jak X game in Left Behind
achievements.sortReason: Use the Jak X cabinet before The Turning in Raja's Arcade.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Left Behind — Fun and Games}, play Raja's Arcade's @mechanic{Jak X cabinet} before using The Turning.

guide.context: Using The Turning advances the arcade sequence, so the Jak X interaction must happen first during the visit.

steps.text: In @loc{Left Behind — Fun and Games}, enter @loc{Raja's Arcade}.
Go to the rear-left corner, use the @mechanic{Jak X racing cabinet}, and watch the complete short scene.

achievements.sortReason: The brick contest occurs in Mallrats before Raja's Arcade.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Left Behind — Mallrats}, smash the red car's seven windows before @npc{Riley} destroys the blue car's seven.

guide.context: The brick contest begins immediately after the Halloween store. A missed throw costs more time than briefly lining up the nearest intact window.

steps.text: In @loc{Left Behind — Mallrats}, leave the Halloween store and accept Riley's brick-throwing contest.
Circle the red vehicle, collect bricks, and destroy its @mechanic{seven intact panes} before Riley finishes the seven-pane blue vehicle.
Reload the checkpoint if Riley announces that only one blue-car window remains while the red car still has intact glass.

achievements.description: Defeat Black Fang without getting hit
achievements.sortReason: The Turning cabinet follows the Jak X interaction in Raja's Arcade.
achievements.summary: At @loc{Raja's Arcade} in Left Behind, defeat @enemy{Black Fang} at The Turning without missing a prompt or taking a hit.

guide.context: The imaginary fight is a quick-time sequence with forgiving timing; an incorrect input is what allows Black Fang to deal damage.

steps.text: In @loc{Left Behind — Fun and Games}, enter @loc{Raja's Arcade} and use @mechanic{The Turning} cabinet on the right.
Enter every displayed quick-time prompt correctly and wait for the Black Fang fight to finish.
Reload the checkpoint immediately if Black Fang lands any hit.

achievements.sortReason: The water-gun match begins immediately after Raja's Arcade.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Left Behind — Fun and Games}, win two rounds of the best-of-three @mechanic{water-gun fight} against @npc{Riley}.

guide.context: The scored match starts after the unscored soaking exchange. The shelves block Riley's view and create a reliable side ambush.

steps.text: Immediately after @loc{Raja's Arcade} in @loc{Left Behind — Fun and Games}, complete the opening water-gun exchange.
During each scored round, reload the water gun while searching, move behind the shelves, and wait for Riley to approach.
Shoot Riley first in two rounds before she wins twice.
steps.note: Reload the checkpoint before losing a second round.

achievements.description: Use bricks or bottles to lure an infected into attacking a human
achievements.sortReason: The mixed infected-and-hunter encounter occurs late in Left Behind.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Left Behind — The Enemy of My Enemy}, use a brick or bottle to make an @enemy{infected} kill a human @enemy{hunter}.

guide.context: Credit requires an infected enemy to land the killing blow on a hunter; merely starting combat between the groups is insufficient.

steps.text: In @loc{Left Behind — The Enemy of My Enemy}, pass through the ventilation shafts and remain on the ledge above the infected.
Collect a @item{brick or bottle} from the ledge and wait for the hunters to enter the area below.
Throw the brick or bottle between the hunters and infected so both groups converge on the sound.
Remain out of the fight until an infected kills a hunter.
steps.note: Reload the checkpoint or use a later mixed encounter if the hunters kill every infected first.
